hooks.text: 扮演塔拉姆的流亡英雄，从太阳王阿兹拉手中夺回被禁锢的魔法
hooks.excerpt: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用多路线与不可预测遭遇把横版清版动作改造成每轮变化的肉鸽冒险
hooks.excerpt: With its fast-paced action and endless replayability, Absolum will challenge you with multiple paths to explore and unpredictable encounters for a new experience each time you play.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把高速连段、施法、魔法反击和稀有道具组合成讲究时机的战斗
hooks.excerpt: Take down Azra’s elite guard with a mix of rapid combo chains and spellcasting powers, unleashing moves that feel as raw as they are strategic. Use magical counters and rare items to turn the tide in your favor and experience a combat system that demands skill and timing, pushing you to craft new strategies at every run to wreak havoc among the enemy ranks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
